description: This file defines the LeaveAllocation class and related functions for managing employee leave allocations, including validation, ledger entries, and carry-forward logic within an HR system.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Custom validation error for overlapping leave allocations.

classes.name: BackDatedAllocationError
classes.description: Custom validation error for backdated leave allocations.

classes.name: OverAllocationError
classes.description: Custom validation error for over-allocating leaves.

classes.name: LessAllocationError
classes.description: Custom validation error for allocating fewer leaves than approved.

classes.name: ValueMultiplierError
classes.description: Custom validation error related to value multipliers.

classes.name: LeaveAllocation
classes.description: Main class managing employee leave allocations, including validation, ledger creation, and carry-forward logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on leave allocation.

methods.name: validate_leave_allocation_days
methods.description: Validates that total allocated leaves do not exceed maximum allowed for the leave type.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles logic when a leave allocation is submitted, including ledger entry creation and expiry of unused leaves if carry-forwarded.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic when a leave allocation is canceled, including ledger adjustments and leave policy updates.

methods.name: on_update_after_submit
methods.description: Updates leave ledger entries after submission if leaves allocated have changed.

methods.name: get_existing_leave_count
methods.description: Calculates existing leave ledger entries for the allocation.

methods.name: validate_against_leave_applications
methods.description: Ensures allocated leaves are not less than already approved leaves.

methods.name: update_leave_policy_assignments_when_no_allocations_left
methods.description: Resets leave policy assignment if no allocations remain.

methods.name: validate_period
methods.description: Checks that the 'to' date is not before the 'from' date.

methods.name: validate_lwp
methods.description: Prevents allocation of leave types marked as leave without pay.

methods.name: validate_allocation_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping leave allocations for the same employee and leave type.

methods.name: validate_back_dated_allocation
methods.description: Prevents backdated allocations if future allocations exist.

methods.name: set_total_leaves_allocated
methods.description: Calculates total leaves including carry-forwarded and newly allocated leaves.

methods.name: limit_carry_forward_based_on_max_allowed_leaves
methods.description: Ensures carry-forwarded leaves do not exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: set_carry_forwarded_leaves_in_previous_allocation
methods.description: Records carry-forwarded leaves in previous allocation record.

methods.name: validate_total_leaves_allocated
methods.description: Ensures total allocated leaves do not exceed days in the period.

methods.name: create_leave_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for leaves, including expiry and carry-forward.
